text.p: Positron Corp said Wednesday it received notice that Nasdaq has delisted the company's stock because the company is not in compliance with Nasdaq's minimum capital and surplus requirements.
The company said the delisting became effective at the close of business Monday.
The company said its securities will now be traded on the OTC Bulletin Board.

"We are disappointed that our securities will no longer be traded on the Nasdaq," company chairman Gary Wood said in a press release. "It is our intention to reapply for listing as soon as we complete our recapitalization and meet the minimum listing requirements."
Positron designs, manufactures, markets and services its POSICAM system, which are medical imaging devices that use positron emission tomography technology, it said.
